clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto To Submit Two Cawapres Names To MPR Today
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is scheduled to present two candidates for vice president to the MPR on November 23.
The MPR has held joint meetings and issued communications to ensure the submission occurs within the established deadline.

clusters.headline: MPR Sets December 11 For Vice President Election And Inauguration
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) has officially rescheduled the vice president election plenary session to December 11, 2026.
Chairman Ahmad Muzani stated that the delay follows feedback regarding procedural rules and the need for careful deliberation to avoid ambiguity.

clusters.headline: Officials Investigate Fatal PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Government ministries and labor advisors have launched investigations into the fatal factory fire in Cikande, Banten, to determine the cause.
Search and rescue operations are ongoing at the site, with 26 remains recovered so far and dozens of individuals still reported as missing.

clusters.headline: Erin Mantan Istri Andre Taulany Jadi Tersangka Kasus Penganiayaan
aiSummaryBullets: Erin Wartia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka atas laporan dugaan penganiayaan terhadap mantan asisten rumah tangganya, Herawati.
Pihak Erin Wartia menyatakan terbuka terhadap peluang perdamaian melalui mekanisme restorative justice.

clusters.headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Proposes Three Vice President Roles
aiSummaryBullets: Sultan Najamudin, Chair of the DPD RI, proposed the potential addition of three vice president positions to support national governance.
The official stated the concept is not intended for the immediate term but is presented as a long-term idea for consideration.

clusters.headline: Jakarta And Regional Officials Respond To Multiple Landslide Events
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta authorities are planning to build a permanent retaining wall in Pejaten Timur following recurring landslides triggered by heavy rain.
Emergency response teams have been deployed to South Jakarta to assist displaced residents and manage the impact of recent soil instability.

clusters.headline: Kapolda Metro Jaya Dadang Hartanto Rombak Jabatan Dan Ungkap Scam
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya mencatat 4.097 kasus penipuan daring antara 2025 hingga November 2026 dengan total kerugian mencapai Rp1,49 triliun.
Komjen Dadang Hartanto memaparkan berbagai modus operandi penipuan daring, termasuk skema percintaan atau love scam dan penggunaan nama instansi.

clusters.headline: Iran Drone And Missile Strikes Hit Civilian Sites In Bahrain
aiSummaryBullets: Iranian-led strikes impacted civilian industrial facilities in Bahrain, causing injuries to at least two individuals.
The casualties have been identified as citizens of Bahrain and Pakistan.

clusters.headline: DKPP Holds Ethics Hearing On Gibran Rakabuming Raka Candidacy Case
aiSummaryBullets: The DKPP is presiding over a hearing regarding alleged ethics violations by the KPU during the 2024 presidential candidacy process.
Complainants, including Denny Indrayana, have questioned the KPU's handling of document verification and regulatory adjustments related to the candidacy.

clusters.headline: KPK To Imprison Three Former Customs Officials In Graft Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) is preparing to execute prison sentences for three former officials.
The officials, identified as Rizal, Sisprian, and Orlando, received sentences of nine, seven, and six years respectively.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Nationals Recruited As Russian Mercenaries Intercepted
aiSummaryBullets: Two Indonesian citizens attempting to join Russian military operations were stopped at an airport in Surabaya.
The individuals allegedly claimed to be traveling for vacation before their recruitment was discovered.

clusters.headline: Twenty Four Confirmed Dead In PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian authorities have recovered 24 bodies from the site of a confectionery factory fire in Cikande.
Rescuers are continuing to search for approximately 30 workers who remain missing following the weekend incident.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Arrests Suspect In Crypto Love Scam Case
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya has apprehended one individual suspected of orchestrating a cryptocurrency investment fraud.
The suspect utilized love scam tactics to deceive the victim into investing funds.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces Finalize 2027 Minimum Wage Increases
aiSummaryBullets: Provincial governments across Indonesia have confirmed 2027 minimum wage increases, including Jakarta at Rp 6.1 million.
Bali and Central Java reported significant percentage increases, while Papua finalized its new rate at Rp 4.66 million.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Questions Witnesses in Alleged Kupang Regent Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: Investigators from the NTT Regional Police have questioned over a dozen witnesses regarding allegations of sexual violence involving Kupang Regent Yosef Lede.
The Ministry of Home Affairs has formally granted permission for authorities to proceed with the examination and potential detention of the official.

clusters.headline: Officials Deny Mining Permits and Rhino Relocation at Ujung Kulon
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials, including Minister Bahlil Lahadalia, confirmed no mining permits have been issued for the Ujung Kulon National Park.
National park authorities identified viral images showing Javan rhinos being loaded onto trucks as fabricated content created by artificial intelligence.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Has Not Submitted Vice President Candidates Yet
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto has yet to provide the People's Consultative Assembly with a list of candidates for the vacant Vice President position.
Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration, and Corrections Yusril Ihza Mahendra confirmed that no names have been submitted to date.

clusters.headline: Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin Denies Military Chief Changes
aiSummaryBullets: Defense Minister Sjafrie Sjamsoeddin stated there are no plans to replace the current Military Commander.
House of Representatives Speaker Puan Maharani confirmed she had not received any presidential letter regarding a change in military leadership.

clusters.headline: Prosecutors Appeal Five Year Sentence For Former Ombudsman Hery Susanto
aiSummaryBullets: Hery Susanto, the former chair of the Ombudsman, was sentenced to five years in prison.
The conviction was based on findings that he accepted bribes related to nickel governance.

clusters.headline: BMKG Issues Severe Weather Alerts For Major Indonesian Cities
aiSummaryBullets: The BMKG issued warnings for light to heavy rain accompanied by lightning and strong winds across many Indonesian cities.
Residents in regions like Jakarta and Bogor are reporting localized weather shifts, including midday heat followed by evening precipitation.
